seo.description: Comprehensive loading state documentation with spinners, skeletons, progress indicators, and Web3 patterns

header.title: Loading State Components
header.description: Loading indicators and progress states that provide clear visual feedback during asynchronous operations, specially designed for Web3 transactions and blockchain interactions.

quickStart.title: 🚀 Quick Start
quickStart.description: Get started with the most commonly used loading patterns. These examples show essential loading states for different use cases.

web3.title: ⚡ Web3 Loading Patterns
web3.description: Specialized loading states for Web3 operations including wallet connections, transactions, and blockchain confirmations.

pending.title: Transaction Pending
pending.message: Please confirm the transaction in your wallet...

confirming.title: Confirming Transaction
confirming.message: Transaction submitted. Waiting for blockchain confirmation...

confirmed.title: Transaction Confirmed
confirmed.message: Your transaction has been confirmed on the blockchain!

connecting.title: Connecting Wallet
connecting.message: Please approve the connection in your wallet

encrypting.title: Encrypting message...
encrypting.message: Securing your email with Web3 encryption

skeletons.title: 💀 Skeleton Patterns
skeletons.description: Content placeholders that mimic the structure of the loading content for better perceived performance.

accessibility.title: ♿ Accessibility Guidelines
accessibility.description: Ensure your loading states are accessible with proper ARIA attributes, screen reader support, and focus management.

bestPractices.title: ✅ Best Practices
items: Use ARIA live regions for dynamic loading states
Use reduced motion for users who prefer it

avoid.title: ❌ Avoid
items: Fast-flashing animations that can trigger seizures
Removing focus or content without warning
